svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a flat pale oxide buries a metal line and a wider metal shape carrying a raised thin plate. After it a violet resist covers the oxide except for two windows, one over the line and one over the plate.

svg.text: Before: the cap oxide over metal 3 (step 143)
Resist is coated, exposed through the VIM3
reticle and developed, opening the via windows.
After: resist with two via-3 windows
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
